subject: Request: Weekend endurance top-up + short trial extension for POC soak
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@lumina.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC weekend endurance - quick ask for extra credits + short extension

Priya — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We kicked off our internal throughput run and the numbers are promising, but we hit a ceiling once we sustained 2k rps for the evening soak.

We have a planned weekend endurance test (48h) to validate tail-latency and KV-cache behavior under sustained load. Two quick asks: can Redwood sponsor an additional ~150k token allowance for the weekend (Fri night -> Sun night) and add a 3-day trial extension so our infra team can finish the soak and sanity checks?

High-level scope:
- Model: 12B open checkpoint (quantized)
- Target sustained traffic: ~1.8k-2.2k rps, with spikes to 3k for short 30m windows
- Main validation: p95/p99 tails, cold-starts across replicas, and autoscaling behavior

I've attached our load plan (lumina_load-plan.xlsx) and included Samir (platform) in case you need more detail. We prefer approval by EOD Thu so we can rehearse the harness.

Appreciate your help — Emma

--
Emma Clarke
Head of ML Infrastructure, Lumina Health Tech
emma@lumina.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: POC weekend endurance - quick ask for extra credits + short extension

Emma — thanks for the clear scope and for attaching the plan. That all sounds reasonable and similar to other weekend soaks we've supported.

Short answers:
- I can put together a provisional promo allowance for 150k tokens for the weekend and a 72-hour trial extension, pending final signoff from our sales manager (Jonas).
- We'll apply standard promo terms (see attached draft) — no charge to Lumina, but we ask for a short post-mortem with the perf artifacts.

Two quick clarifications to speed approval:
1) Do you need the allowance to start Fri 18:00 PT or earlier?
2) Will you use the Hosted API or a Dedicated trial cluster for the soak (affects routing/limits)?

If you confirm those two points I will loop Jonas for the final green light.

Thanks — Priya

Finance/billing note: Stephanie, flag this as a waived promo for reporting; use code PROMO-POC-2025-077.

Jonas
